Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system

Class Opener

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.Opener
public final class Opener extends Object
Opens files, folders and URIs with the user's preferred applications and moves files to the trash, using the freedesktop.org conventions.

Opening first consults the user's FileAssociations: when a file-type association is configured (say, the desktop's PDF Viewer for .pdf) that handler wins, whether it names one of the desktop's own applications (delegated to the registered FileAssociationLauncher) or an external executable (run as a child process with %f expanded). With no association, opening delegates to xdg-open. Trashing prefers gio trash and falls back to a manual move into $XDG_DATA_HOME/Trash (writing a compliant .trashinfo sidecar) when gio is absent. All of it is optional: if the tools are missing the operations report failure instead of throwing, so the file manager and the dock stacks can show a message.

No JNI/JNA; pure JDK plus the standard desktop CLI tools.

    • setFileAssociationLauncher

      public static void setFileAssociationLauncher(FileAssociationLauncher launcher)
      Registers the desktop's internal-application launcher, or null to clear it. The 2D desktop sets this at start-up so a file-type association naming one of the desktop's own applications opens inside the desktop; without it such a handler falls through to an external launch. See FileAssociationLauncher.

      public static boolean openWith(String command, Path path)
      Opens path with an explicit handler command - the shared path for a configured association and for an ad-hoc "Open With".
